one_line: Maratha naval commander who dominated the Konkan coast and defied European fleets in the early 18th century.

appearance.age_look: Late 40s to early 50s, broad-shouldered and compact, with a sailor’s solid musculature and weathered stamina.
appearance.face: Oval face with strong jaw, medium-brown coastal Konkan complexion, sun‑lined forehead, straight nose, thick dark brows, and a neatly trimmed full moustache with short beard along the jaw; default expression is calm, focused confidence with a steady, appraising gaze.
appearance.hair: Black hair drawn into a traditional Maratha-style topknot at the back of the crown, sides and back cut short for practicality; he wears a deep‑red Maratha-style turban (pagadi) wrapped low and firm, with a narrow gold trim along the base and a simple, small metal brooch at the left temple.
appearance.costume: He wears a long off‑white cotton angarkha (crossover upper garment) reaching just below the knee, with a wrapped front tied on the right side, its edges piped with narrow maroon edging; over this is a sleeveless, snug, dark‑indigo quilted cotton vest (light padded armour) with minimal stitching lines; his lower garment is a pair of deep‑blue cotton churidar-style tight trousers gathered at the ankles, tucked into mid‑calf brown leather boots with simple stitching, practical for ship decks; around his waist is a broad dark‑red cotton sash (kamarband) wrapped several times and knotted slightly to the left, holding his scabbard; over one shoulder he wears a narrow, sea‑green cotton stole (uttariya) with a subtle striped weave, usually slung from left shoulder to right side like a lightweight officer’s scarf; simple yet dignified jewellery: small gold hoop earrings, a thin gold chain at the neck, and a plain signet-style ring on his right hand; all fabrics look slightly weathered, hinting at sea exposure but kept orderly.
appearance.signature: A slightly curved Maratha talwar with a brass hilt and disc pommel, housed in a plain dark‑brown leather scabbard with minimal metal fittings, always worn slung from his left hip on the red sash so the hilt angles slightly forward for a quick naval commander’s draw.

ref_desc: Sarkhel Kanhoji Angre is a medium-brown, strong-jawed, moustached Maratha naval commander with a black topknot under a deep-red turban, wearing an off-white angarkha, dark-indigo quilted vest, blue churidar trousers, red sash, sea-green stole, and carrying a curved talwar at his left hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Sarkhel Kanhoji Angre as a dignified early-18th-century Maratha naval commander on the Konkan coast: a medium-brown man in his late 40s–50s with an oval, strong-jawed face, thick dark brows, a neatly trimmed full moustache and short beard along the jaw, and a calm, confident expression; his black hair is pulled into a traditional topknot at the back of the crown, with sides and back cut short, and he wears a deep-red Maratha turban with narrow gold trim and a small metal brooch at the left temple. Show him in an off-white cotton angarkha that wraps right-over-left to just below the knee, its edges piped with maroon, over which he has a snug, sleeveless dark-indigo quilted cotton vest suggesting light padded armour. His lower body has deep-blue churidar-style tight trousers gathered at the ankles, tucked into mid-calf brown leather boots with simple stitching suitable for ship decks. Around his waist is a broad dark-red cotton sash wrapped several times and knotted slightly left, supporting a plain dark-brown leather scabbard so the curved talwar’s brass hilt and disc pommel angle forward for a quick draw; a narrow sea-green cotton stole with a subtle striped weave hangs from his left shoulder across his chest. Add small gold hoop earrings, a thin gold chain at his neck, and a simple ring on his right hand, and keep all fabrics modest, fully covering his torso and legs; render front, side, and three-quarter views with consistent colours and proportions, emphasizing his authoritative naval posture and sea-hardened yet orderly appearance.
